entities.name: Insurance Claims Modernization platform
entities.description: A hybrid cloud-native platform gradually replacing an on-premise mainframe system while ensuring continuous, zero-loss claim processing during a 3-year transition.

entities.name: Customers & Brokers
entities.description: External users performing online claim submissions.

entities.name: Claims Adjusters
entities.description: Internal users handling claims via the new web application.

entities.name: Legacy Mainframe
entities.description: On-premise COBOL/DB2 system of record with a 3-year retention constraint.

entities.name: Azure AD (Entra ID)
entities.description: Identity provider for Single Sign-On and RBAC.

entities.name: Payment Gateway
entities.description: External financial system for automated claim payouts.

entities.name: Core Notification Service
entities.description: External system for automated SMS/email updates.

entities.name: Enterprise Service Bus (ESB/MQ)
entities.description: Hybrid messaging intermediary for asynchronous decoupling.

interfaces.description: Handle claims via web application UI
Asynchronous data synchronization and queue transfers
Process automated claim payouts with idempotency tokens
Send automated SMS and email updates
interfaces.protocol: Asynchronous Webhooks via Azure Event Grid (HTTPS)

naming_conventions: External systems are named after their third-party or enterprise product names.
People roles use descriptive plural forms or role titles.
Interfaces specify concrete protocols and technologies such as HTTPS and ESB/MQ.
